# Word cloud dependencies

- Apache ECharts 5.6.0: `echarts-5.6.0.min.js`, Apache-2.0 (`echarts.LICENSE`, `echarts.NOTICE`), from the `echarts@5.6.0` npm package.
- echarts-wordcloud 2.1.0: `echarts-wordcloud-2.1.0.min.js`, ISC, from the `echarts-wordcloud@2.1.0` npm package ([upstream](https://github.com/ecomfe/echarts-wordcloud)).

Both files are served locally so the audit report does not need a CDN connection.
